best_idea: Derive every frame value (self, group, target) once per server tick from state, diff it against the last value sent to each viewer, and send one batched packet per viewer with only the changed entries, carrying the target's percent on the combat event so the target frame never waits.
decision_why: The per-tick snapshot, the diff and one batch per viewer are what Frankendom needs for many-on-one target frames; the donor's cache-and-hook chain is rejected because it caused the stale pet frame and a notify from a getter.
acceptance: Server test: after a pet takes damage, the next tick's frame update for its owner has exactly one entry for that pet with the new percent; a tick with no change sends no frame packet; a hit on the locked enemy carries that enemy's percent in the same tick's combat event.
